shortlist_scope: Best retained variant per family; engine ranking unchanged.
premium_risk_note: “No” additional loss does not mean no risk: premium can still be lost.
kelly_fallback: Kelly selected, but no distribution is set for this trade: sizes use fixed-loss fallback.
narration_rules: Use net P&L at the specified target, not maximum payout, for the target metric. It is a scenario result, not a promised return or a probability of success.
Keep premium paid or received, loss budget, sizing loss measure and contractual maximum loss distinct. A sizing budget or stop reference is not a guaranteed exit or loss limit.
No additional loss beyond premium does not mean risk-free. Unknown risk is not safe risk; bounded loss does not mean loss is limited to premium.
Use expiry payoff only at expiry. Before expiry, call the supplied valuation mark-to-market and keep its horizon and assumptions.
Relay numerical ranges from engine text in ascending order, preserving endpoint roles. Never reorder leg ratios or change which strike belongs to which leg.
Copy the supplied currency and full monetary units. Do not scale amounts again or convert currencies yourself.
Zero allocation is a computed outcome, not missing data. Unavailable quantities must stay unavailable, with the supplied reason.
Do not call stale snapshots live market data. Use only the as-of information actually supplied; a refresh alone does not establish freshness.
